summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass) and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the seven-step procedure: Literal raises TypeError; non-Node inputs (None, strings) are rejected before any graph lookup; IRIs return unchanged except rdf:nil; rdf:first lists use graph.items() with a fewer-than-two check; sh:inversePath, sh:alternativePath, and the three modifiers (sh:zeroOrMorePath, sh:oneOrMorePath, sh:zeroOrOnePath) are handled via MulPath with "*", "+", "?". Added test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with one parametrized valid/invalid test that also checks the graph is unchanged, plus a non-node input test. Results: test_shacl.py and test/test_path.py pass (39 tests). Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv and I did not install them, so type-check and formatting were only checked by hand (line widths ≤ 88). No commits made.
